responsibility: Implements the AVX10.2 rounding-control intrinsic header for 256-bit arithmetic and comparison operations. It exposes explicit-rounding forms of packed add, subtract, scale, sqrt, and compare operations for FP32, FP64, and FP16 vectors, along with compatibility aliases for complex-half multiply helpers, making this file the AVX10.2 API surface dedicated to embedded rounding semantics rather than general arithmetic.
